bugs.desc: oxygen_profile recommended a maximum channel spacing of 400 um at which its own diffusion model computes exactly 0% midpoint oxygen (hypoxic=True). The recommendation is now derived from the model: largest spacing with midpoint >= 5% oxygen (floor(400*sqrt(0.95)*10)/10 = 389.8 um, verified 5.03% and not hypoxic).
oxygen_profile(channel_spacing_um=0) was silently replaced by the 500 um fallback (falsy-or), making the 'must be positive' validation unreachable for 0. Now explicit None check; 0 raises ValueError.
calibrate_printing predicted negative structural fidelity for large nozzles (5000 um -> -0.12, 10000 um -> -1.12, 100000 um -> -19.12); now clamped to [0, 0.99].
design_tissue/oxygen_profile accepted invalid size_mm: a 2-tuple crashed IndexError, negative/zero thickness silently yielded n_layers=1. Now shared validation: three positive dimensions.
